theme_preference: Both Light and Dark mode supported, utilizing an 'Organic & Earthy' approach tailored for Indonesian UMKM. High contrast, warm, and highly tactile.

rules: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (font-black or font-extrabold) for amounts, live totals, and top-level headings to give them a premium, authoritative look.
Use 'Outfit' for all product titles, table data, and UI elements for high legibility.
Strictly enforce tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) on large numbers (prices, totals).
No generic Inter or Roboto fonts.
The primary color (Terracotta/Orange) represents energy and commerce. Use it strictly for the primary CTAs (Pay/Bayar, Confirm Restock).
Use 'Tinted Grey' for borders and backgrounds. Never use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF without context.
Live IDR Totals should pop—use primary color or high-contrast text.
Ensure text over backgrounds meets a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

visual_enhancers.pos_products: Neumorphism (Tactile) - Use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40) with a slight top-left light/bottom-right dark shadow to make product cards feel incredibly clickable (like physical POS keys).
visual_enhancers.bottom_action_bar: Glassmorphism - backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 (or bg-slate-900/80 in dark mode) with a delicate 1px top border. MUST sit fixed at bottom z-50.
visual_enhancers.modals: Flat solid surfaces with max 8px border-radius. Do not use glass on OCR Review or QRIS modals to ensure absolute data legibility.
visual_enhancers.general: Avoid default Shadcn card looks. Add 1px borders and slight shadow-sm. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.

layouts.global: Mobile-first. Hide desktop sidebar on mobile, show bottom navigation bar. On desktop, standard 250px left sidebar.
layouts.pos_screen: On mobile: Product grid takes full height minus header and bottom bar. Cart is accessible via a floating FAB or bottom sheet. On desktop: 70% left for product grid, 30% right for sticky cart sidebar.
layouts.inventory_screen: High-density data grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4). Use 'Bento' strategy for the Analytics dashboard on this screen.
layouts.spacing: Use generous padding inside containers. Use p-4 for mobile cards, p-6 or p-8 for desktop panels.

components.pos_product_card: Vertical stack: Image (h-24 object-cover), Title (truncate 2 lines), Price (Rp). Use absolute positioning for stock count badge.
components.cart_drawer: Shadcn Sheet component for mobile, right-aligned. Contains list of items, quantity +/- buttons, discount input, tax info, and huge 'BAYAR' (Pay) button.
components.midtrans_qris_modal: Shadcn Dialog. Clean, centered QR code image. Underneath: Animated polling status (Lucide Loader2 spinning) checking for payment. No glassmorphism.
components.ocr_review_drawer: Bottom Sheet or Dialog showing extracted Receipt data (Name, Qty, Cost). Use Shadcn Table or dense input grid inside so merchant can edit before Confirming.
components.analytics_bento: Mode B (High Density Grid). gap-4. Use Shadcn Charts (Recharts). AI Business Insights goes into a 'Tracing Beam' highlighted card.
components.printer_manager: Settings form utilizing Shadcn Form, Input, and standard interactive buttons. List paired bluetooth devices.

motion.interactions: All buttons MUST have hover:scale-[0.98] active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200. Hover states must shift background color slightly.
motion.polling: Smooth pulse animation on the Midtrans waiting status text.

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first design. Build for mobile screens first, enhance for desktop.
responsive.layout: Use flex-col for mobile, switching to flex-row / grid-cols-2+ at md breakpoint.
responsive.typography: Fluid typography or explicit step-downs (text-4xl md:text-5xl). Inputs must be min 16px font size on mobile to prevent iOS zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Use overflow-x-hidden on the main container to prevent horizontal scrolling. Allow horizontal scroll specifically only inside data tables.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons, POS items, and list items MUST be min 44x44px for touch accuracy.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary orange meets 3:1 on white/dark for buttons, 4.5:1 for text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pos-product-1', data-testid='cart-pay-button', data-testid='qris-modal-status').

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all iconography (shopping-cart, printer, scan, qrcode, chart-bar). Use stroke-width 1.5 for elegance.

instructions_to_main_agent: CREATE FILES USING .js AND .jsx EXTENSIONS. DO NOT USE .tsx
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or plain Bootstrap-style cards. Elevate the design with 1px borders, careful shadow layering, and high-contrast typography.
FORMAT CURRENCY PROPERLY: Use Intl.NumberFormat for IDR (Rp). Do not use decimals for IDR unless absolutely necessary.
Create a mobile-first sticky bottom navigation for mobile, and a left sidebar for desktop views.
For the POS grid, prioritize huge tap targets and fast scanning. Images should be crisp, text highly readable.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons. Do NOT use AI emojis (e.g., 🤖, 💡) as icons.
Integrate Shadcn UI but heavily customize the rounded corners (max 8px) and border colors to match the earthy/warm Indonesian vibe.
Ensure 'Stok Menipis' (low stock alerts) use the Warning (#F59E0B) or Error (#DC2626) colors boldly.
The Midtrans QRIS modal must include a realistic polling state (spinner + 'Menunggu Pembayaran...').
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, configured at /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Provide clear data-testid attributes for everything (buttons, inputs, totals) to ensure automated tests pass.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent MUST USE the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
